a1.title: The Narrow Beam
a1.note: playable beam: five sounding places, one shy thing you can't hear while looking at

b1.title: Didn't You Notice
b1.note: playable flicker: tap the change the blink swallowed; some rounds only the sound changes

c1.title: One Thing
c1.note: playable binding toy: drag colour and voice onto the wandering form; the almost-zone audibly beats

d1.title: Seeing With Your Ears
d1.note: playable dark room: one humming voice, pan/pitch/loudness for place; each catch lights a star

a2.title: Trust the Feeling
a2.note: playable blindsight hunt: hold and wander, a beating drone stills near the mark; letting go early pays

b2.title: Below the Line
b2.note: playable priming run: nine free choices over hidden pushes; the replay shows the strings

c2.title: The Guessing Machine
c2.note: playable prediction round: your taps render the world; wrong guesses sound fine, then sting

d2.title: What Red Sounds Like
d2.note: playable translation: sculpt your color in sound; the other mind's coarse ear guesses, and hums back what survived

a3.title: Where I End
a3.note: playable body: linger to absorb, each part joins the heartbeat; let one go and the heart skips

b3.title: Two Minds
b3.note: playable split-brain: flashes one half sees, both thumbs answer; the speaking half confabulates

c3.title: The Inward Ear
c3.note: playable duet with a heartbeat: ride the breath with one thumb; the body slows and deepens when you listen

d3.title: Who You Were
d3.note: playable thread: recall the phrase you left to prove you're still you; each sitting adds a note, misremembering frays

a4.title: The Width of Now
a4.note: playable time-grain toy: drag the band to stretch the moment; beats fuse into chords or shatter into a line
